supported: Values between two distinct real row fields in tabular/compact/outline, 2 to 16 measures, optional column axis, automatic/disabled subtotals and repeated real row labels. The Values pseudo-field caption itself is not repeated by RepeatAllLabels.
nativeXml: rowFields [real,-2,real], dataPosition=1, measure-major tuples [outer,measure,inner], rowItems i is measure index, prefix r=2 repeats outer/measure. Layout conversions retain this placement. Last/columns/one-row/one-measure transitions clear stale metadata.
preserved: Values first, custom Values captions/visible headers, grouping/filters/slicers/shared cache/custom indentation/subtotals and malformed or inconsistent dataPosition remain unsupported.
scope: Every native cached/refreshed cell value/type/dimension, compact indentation and left alignment, errors/sparse/min/max/16 measures/repeated labels, six layout conversions and fifteen axis/placement/collapse transitions. Source XML preservation, history and browser export/reopen are checked.
reuse: Existing indexed hierarchy buckets and aggregate primitive; single-measure projection avoids recomputing all measures for each between-field detail row. No parallel engine or relevant PPTX migration.
